Content: A solid disk of mass `M` and radius `R` is freely rotating horizontally in a counterclockwise direction with angular speed `omega` about a vertical axis through its center with negligible friction. the rotational inertia of the disk is `MR^2//2`. A `text(second)` identical disk is at rest and suspended above the `text(first)` disk with the centers of the `text(two)` disks aligned, as shown in the figure above. there is no contact between the disks. The `text(second)` disk is dropped onto the `text(first)` disk, and after a short time they rotate counterclockwise with the same angular speed `omega_f`.
